meta.title: Wuthering Waves · Aemeath Companion
meta.description: Aemeath from Wuthering Waves keeps you company in DeepSeek Harness: three expression presets (鸭牌, 雾雪, Stephen) follow your tasks, and she answers in her own voice with subtitles when a turn finishes. Pat her, drag her, pick your own stickers, voices and lines, and import Aemeath sticker packs downloaded from 呜哇小站. Windows 10/11 x64 with a local Harness; the first launch downloads the full program.
